title: Long string input in username field does not crash or bypass login
steps: Enter a 500-character string of "a" in the Username field
expected_result: The application does not crash or return a 500 error; login is rejected with the standard "Your username is invalid!" error, and the login page remains fully functional.

title: XSS-style payload in username field is not executed or reflected
expected_result: No JavaScript alert/dialog fires, the payload is not reflected as executable markup anywhere in the resulting page's DOM, and login is rejected with the standard "Your username is invalid!" error.

title: SQL-injection-style payload does not bypass authentication
steps: Enter "' OR '1'='1" in the Username field
Enter "' OR '1'='1" in the Password field
expected_result: Login is rejected with the standard "Your username is invalid!" error (no authentication bypass), and no server error (500) or unhandled exception occurs.

title: Whitespace-only username and password are treated as invalid, not empty
steps: Enter three space characters in the Username field
Enter three space characters in the Password field
expected_result: Login is rejected with error flash message "Your username is invalid!" — whitespace is not trimmed to an empty value that would trigger different handling, and no crash occurs.

title: Unicode characters in username field are accepted without crashing
steps: Enter "тестユーザー日本語" in the Username field
expected_result: The application accepts the unicode input without crashing or rendering errors; login is rejected with the standard "Your username is invalid!" error.
